title: The 7th Guest Philips-logo audio hits
symptom: One or two brief audible hits or glitches occur near the start of the opening Philips logo clip.
expected: The opening Philips logo audio plays cleanly without transient hits while the clip and following MPEG sequence remain synchronized.

input_events: manual click through pre-title Philips logo clip

hypotheses.hardware_explanation: The short transient may occur while the MPEG Layer-II path acquires its first complete frame or while the emulated VMPEG/audio mixer begins presenting a newly primed buffer.
supporting_evidence: The hits occur only once or twice near the start of the opening clip.
The following MPEG stages and gameplay audio continue normally in the same run.
contradicting_evidence: No bounded audio-event trace or captured waveform has yet located the transient.
The sound may be authored in the source clip or introduced at the host audio transport boundary rather than inside VMPEG.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Capture the on-disc MP2 payload, decoded PCM before mixing, mixed core PCM, and frontend output around clip start. The first stage containing the transient identifies whether it is authored, decoder/buffer behavior, mixing, or CPAL presentation.

manual_verification.notes: During a clean-NVRAM seven-stage opening pass, the user heard one or two brief audio hits near the start of the opening Philips logo. The remainder of the title/post-title/gameplay sequence proceeded.
